claims.text: The source defines MusicLM: frozen SoundStream acoustic tokens (50 Hz, RVQ 12x1024, 6 kbps) plus w2v-BERT semantic tokens (25 Hz) plus MuLan joint text-music tokens (128-d, 10 s window); training conditions semantic on MuLan-audio tokens and acoustic on both, swapped to MuLan-text tokens at inference; three 430M decoder-only Transformers with temperature 1.0/0.95/0.4; story-mode 15 s-stride continuation and melody-condition extension.

Reported numbers: MusicCaps 10 s eval FAD-VGG 4.0 vs Mubert 9.6 vs Riffusion 13.4, KLD 1.01 vs 1.19/1.58, MCC 0.51 vs 0.34/0.32, human wins 312 vs 158/97 (1200 ratings) vs reference 472; no-semantic ablation KLD 1.01 to 1.05, MCC 0.51 to 0.49; memorisation exact <0.2%, approximate <0.01% false-positive.

limitations.text: Inherits MuLan failures on negation and temporal ordering; MCC favours own method; 30 s training extended autoregressively, no verse/chorus model; no model release.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

limitations.text: Beat/chord/key-precise controllability and local-fidelity codec comparisons beyond MuLan/MusicCaps conditions not established.
